items.title: Walmart raises its outlook for the year for the 3rd time after a solid quarter
items.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Walmart reported solid third quarter sales gains as the retailer continues to attract a growing number of customers across the economic spectrum that are seeking to cut costs in the face of rising prices. The company topped Wall Street’s profit and sales projections and it raised its annual guidance for the third time this year, but the outlook released Thursday was more conservative than industry analysts had expected.
